prompt: Flat sticker illustration of a real Japanese object, simple and clean: thick uniform dark chocolate brown outlines (#4A2219) around every shape, flat solid fills, rounded soft shapes, no gradients, no texture, no shading, no highlights, no drop shadow. Color the object in its real natural colors, slightly softened and warm, using as few colors as possible. Never rainbow or multicolor: parts of the same kind share the same color. Clean plain surfaces. Subject: A deep round dark indigo bowl of soba in clear brown broth, topped with five separate toppings laid side by side: two half-moon slices of white kamaboko fish cake with pink rims placed as a pair, one round narutomaki slice with a pink spiral, one brown simmered shiitake cap with a cross cut on top, and a small bundle of green spinach, seen from the front and slightly above, no steam. Single isolated object, centered, generous empty margin around it. The object is not a character: it has no face, no eyes, no mouth, no blush. No ground shadow, no floor, no character, no animal, no creature, no head under it, no hands, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo. Plain solid flat light gray background filling the whole image.
